note: 16 vulnerability indicators across four domains (2 + 4 + 4 + 6), plus one pre-survey point for age, summing to a maximum of 17. Scoring rules are quoted from the published tool.

bands.name: No housing intervention
bands.action: No housing intervention at this time

bands.name: Permanent Supportive Housing
bands.action: An assessment for Permanent Supportive Housing / Housing First

indicators.name: Age
indicators.rule: If the person is 60 years of age or older, then score 1.

indicators.name: Housing status
indicators.rule: If the person answers anything other than "shelter", "transitional housing", or "safe haven", then score 1.

indicators.name: Duration and episodes
indicators.rule: If the person has experienced 1 or more consecutive years of homelessness, and/or 4+ episodes of homelessness, then score 1.

indicators.name: Emergency Service Use
indicators.rule: If the total number of interactions equals 4 or more, then score 1 for emergency service use.

indicators.name: Risk of Harm
indicators.rule: If "yes" to any of the above, then score 1 for risk of harm.

indicators.name: Legal Issues
indicators.rule: If "yes," then score 1 for legal issues.

indicators.name: Risk of Exploitation
indicators.rule: If "yes" to any of the above, then score 1 for risk of exploitation.

indicators.name: Money Management
indicators.rule: If "yes" to question 10 or "no" to question 11, then score 1 for money management.

indicators.name: Meaningful Daily Activity
indicators.rule: If "no," then score 1 for meaningful daily activity.

indicators.name: Social Relationships
indicators.rule: If "yes," then score 1 for social relationships.

indicators.name: Physical Health
indicators.rule: If "yes" to any of the above, then score 1 for physical health.

indicators.name: Substance Use
indicators.rule: If "yes" to any of the above, then score 1 for substance use.

indicators.name: Mental Health
indicators.rule: If "yes" to any of the above, then score 1 for mental health.

indicators.name: Tri-Morbidity
indicators.rule: If the respondent scored 1 for physical health and 1 for substance use and 1 for mental health, score 1 for tri-morbidity.

indicators.name: Medications
indicators.rule: If "yes" to any of the above, score 1 for medications.

indicators.name: Abuse and Trauma
indicators.rule: If "yes", score 1 for abuse and trauma.
